A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Critic-V research work and complete supplementary Sections 6–14. Text and visual inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, figures, and appendices despite some appendix reflow.

before.justification: v4 reports original Critic-V benchmark evaluations, ablations, token-consumption measurements, and training curves in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v5 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablations, token-consumption measurements, and training curves.

M1.justification: Section 9 replaces explicitly stated full-parameter critic fine-tuning with LoRA-based tuning. This is a localized change to the reported training procedure; the DPO objective, preference-data construction, and Reasoner-Critic inference procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the 29,012-sample critique-VQA training dataset and the same eight evaluation benchmarks. Sections 3.1 and 14 introduce no different tasks, populations, or test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Table 1 retains its VLM comparisons, Table 2 retains POVID, CSR, SIMA, and SCL, and Tables 3–4 retain Self-Refine and prompt-only comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 9 substantially revises the stated training configuration: DPO beta changes from 0.1 to 1.0, learning rate from 5e-5 to 5e-6, epochs from 5 to 3, warm-up from 1% to 10%, and sequence length from 1024 to 2048. Batch size 2 is replaced by a per-device microbatch of 1 with eight accumulation steps. These are reported setting revisions; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun. Section 10's inference settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The DPO/Self-Refine and prompt ablations, token-consumption analysis, case studies, training diagnostics, and dataset examples retain the same evidence. Appendix relocation adds no new analysis.

E5.justification: Table 6 retains the same token-count means and standard deviations. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures.

E6.justification: Benchmark and ablation scores, token-count statistics, training curves, and qualitative examples are unchanged. The revised training recipe is not accompanied by a new or revised experimental result set.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9 and the mathematical content of Algorithms 1–3 are unchanged. The training-setting revisions introduce no new definitions, derivations, assumptions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about external critique, the preference dataset, plug-and-play applicability, and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reasoning improvements, DPO's contribution, prompt effects, computational overhead, and training convergence are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Section 9 substantially replaces the critic's reproducibility recipe, specifying LoRA rank 8, LoRA alpha 16, all target modules, bf16 precision, a 262,144-pixel image cap, and gradient accumulation alongside revised hyperparameters. It removes the four-A100 hardware specification and approximately 2.5 GPU-hours-per-epoch disclosure. Code and dataset access links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 69 references are unchanged, with no revised novelty positioning or relationship to earlier research.

P1.justification: Section 9 is locally rewritten into two paragraphs, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. The remaining prose, section order, and overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: The final appendix pages reflow existing figures and tables. For example, Figure 10 moves from PDF page 15 to 16, Table 7 moves from page 16 to 15, and Figure 8 changes columns. Display content, numbering, and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 supplies useful LoRA, precision, and batching details, and its 10% warm-up better matches Figure 8 than v4's 1%. However, it removes hardware/time information, while its revised learning rate of 5e-6 conflicts with the retained figure's peak of 5e-5. The PDFs do not explain whether the training recipe corrects earlier documentation or describes different experiments, leaving the net effect on reproducibility and reliability uncertain.
